title: What to buy
sub: All the electronics, the lock, the hardware and the printing for one complete dock and case, with where to get it in India. Details in SHOPPING_LIST_INDIA.md and WIRING.md.

groups.label: Dock electronics
groups.note: The dock board: hand-wired on perfboard (option A) or an ordered PCB (option B, below). Prices as listed on 2026-11-20.

items.name: AO3401A P-MOSFET
items.for: Switches 5 V onto the pins only while a case is docked

items.name: 2N7002 MOSFET
items.for: Shorts the red OFF LED while power is on

items.name: USBLC6-2SC6 USB ESD protection (ST)
items.for: Protects the USB data lines

items.name: Resettable fuse 1.5 A (ASMD1210-150)
items.for: Over-current protection

items.name: 3 mm LEDs: yellow, green, red
items.for: PWR, DOCK and OFF lights

items.name: Resistors (1k x 4, 10k, 100k x 2) + 10 µF capacitor
items.for: The switch and LED circuits

items.name: Perfboard 8 x 12 cm, double-sided
items.for: The dock board (option A)

items.name: P75-B1 pogo pins, packs of 5
items.for: The 10 contacts (2 rows); a third pack for spares is optional

items.name: KSD9700 thermostat, 45 °C, normally closed
items.for: Cuts the charging if the case gets hot

items.name: Case lead: USB-A to 90° USB-C (or 90° micro-USB)
items.for: From the case's pads to the phone

items.name: Bike lead: any USB-A cable, to cut
items.for: Wired straight into the dock

items.name: 12 V handlebar USB charger
items.for: Only if your bike has no USB socket (wire it after the ignition)

items.name: Thermal pad 0.5 mm (optional)
items.for: Better heat sensing at the thermostat

groups.label: Option B: an ordered PCB instead of perfboard

items.name: Dock board PCB (21.5 x 14.5 mm), 2-layer, 1.6 mm (and the pin and pad strips if you like)
items.for: Replaces the perfboard; you get 5 of each
items.where: JLCPCB is the alternative: cheap boards, but international delivery and duty. Ask for ENIG (gold) on the pad strip.

items.name: 16 mm cam lock, quarter turn (confirm the turn with the seller)
items.for: The store lock; its own cam becomes the crank
items.where: The same lock is ₹275 on Flipkart.

items.name: 3.2 mm drill bit + M3 bolt, nut and a 4 mm OD spacer
items.for: The crank pin (store lock)

items.name: 14 x 9 mm key steel (DIN 6885), cut 15 mm + 10 mm
items.for: The lock bolt and its bearing block (every lock)
items.where: A bearing or power-transmission shop: ask them to cut it.

items.name: Small compression springs, 3 mm OD, 0.3 mm wire (stainless)
items.for: The printed lock (4, about 8 mm, 9 coils or fewer), the tubular lock (6, about 10 mm, 8 coils or fewer) or the dial lock (3)

items.name: Steel dowel pin, 4 x 8 mm
items.for: The tubular lock's crank

items.name: M3 x 8 countersunk socket screw (ISO 10642)
items.for: The tubular lock's plug to its crank

items.name: M3 heat-set inserts
items.for: Case and dock screws

items.name: M3 / M5 screws, nuts, washers
items.for: Assembly and the clamps

items.name: M5 round spacers, 8 mm OD, 10 mm long, + M5 plain washers
items.for: Compression limiters at the clamp bolts (one-piece base)

items.name: M5 rubber washers (about 2 mm) + M5 x 15 large steel washers (DIN 9021)
items.for: Damping at the clamp bolts (one-piece base)
items.local: Nagdevi Street, or a rubber/seal shop

items.name: 2 mm neoprene or EPDM sheet offcut (or print iso_pad in TPU 95A)
items.for: The 2 clamp pads (24 x 50 mm each)

items.name: Rubber grommets with sleeves (bike side-panel type)
items.for: The modular base plate

items.name: 1.5 mm silicone O-ring cord
items.for: The case's back-cover seal

items.name: 2 mm polycarbonate offcut (not acrylic: it cracks)
items.for: The case's window

items.name: Araldite Klear, 10 g
items.for: Window bond, potting the lead, the bearing block

items.name: Bar shims: strips of old bicycle inner tube
items.for: Instead of printing bar_shim

items.name: Printing: about 405 cm³, 340–390 g (PETG or ASA)
items.for: Clamps at 100 % infill, the rest 4 walls and 30–40 %. Get 2–3 quotes: it's the biggest cost

totals: Option A: dock board on perfboard
Option B: dock board on an ordered PCB
note: Assumes you already have a soldering iron, solder and a multimeter. Robu shipping is about ₹50–100 (est.).
